responsibility: Public interface for the GNU Modula-2 tree pretty-printer utilities implemented in m2pp.cc. It declares the maintainer/debug helper entry points used to dump trees, expressions, types, and variable-related forms in Modula-2-oriented syntax, acting as the header companion for internal inspection facilities rather than front-end parsing or driver behavior.
same_name_distinction: Public interface header for the m2 pretty-printer: it declares maintainer dump entry points such as pf/pe/pt, while m2pp.cc provides the actual pretty-print traversal and formatting implementation.
